description: Look up a licensed US real estate agent on the official state license register and get the brokerage of record, the brokerage's active agent count and size band (1, 2-15, 16-50, 51+), and the agent's license status and expiry. Covers 19 states; brokerage data in CA, IA, MO, NV, NY, OH, OR, TX, and VT. Three modes: lookup (one agent or a list, by license number or by name), roster_firm (active agents at one brokerage), and roster_zip (brokerage offices in a zip code, NY, MO, OR, and VT). Returns no emails, phone numbers, or home addresses. Ambiguous or unmatched inputs return a free row with row_status explaining why. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per matched row.

active_only.description: Roster modes. List only agents with an active license. Default true.

agent_name.description: Lookup mode, when there is no license number. First and last name. Add brokerage_name or city to narrow a common name.

agents.description: Lookup mode, many at once. One per line: state | name | brokerage (optional) | city (optional).

brokerage_license_number.description: roster_firm mode. The brokerage's license number.

brokerage_name.description: Lookup mode: narrows a name match. roster_firm mode: the brokerage to list, by its exact registered name.

city.description: Lookup mode: narrows a name match by the brokerage office city or the license county.

include_agents.description: roster_zip mode. true also lists the active agents at each office. Default false.

license_number.description: Lookup mode. The agent's license number as the state register prints it, for example 134224-SA. The most reliable lookup.

licenses.description: Lookup mode, many at once. One per line: state then license number, for example TX 0123456.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before the row that would take its charges over this amount.

max_results.description: Roster modes. Most rows one brokerage or zip returns, 1 to 1000. Default 100.

mode.description: lookup finds one agent or a list. roster_firm lists the active agents at one brokerage. roster_zip lists brokerage offices in a zip code (NY, MO, OR, VT). Default lookup.

state.description: Two letter licensing state, for example TX. Used with license_number, agent_name, or the brokerage fields.

zip.description: roster_zip mode. A five digit zip code.

zips.description: roster_zip mode, many at once. One zip code per line.

name: resolve_agent_brokerage
title: Resolve agent brokerage
